steps.welcome.title: Welcome to ThreatCaddy
steps.welcome.description: Your browser-based threat investigation workspace — private and offline by default.
steps.dashboard.title: Dashboard
steps.dashboard.description: Customizable quick-link tiles for VirusTotal, Shodan, MITRE ATT&CK, and more.
steps.search-create.title: Search & Create
steps.search-create.description: Ctrl+K to search everything. Use "+ New" to create notes, tasks, events, or import data.
steps.investigations.title: Investigations
steps.investigations.description: Organize work into color-coded investigations with status tracking and TLP/PAP classification.
steps.notes-editor.title: Notes
steps.notes-editor.description: Markdown editor with live preview, slash commands, and [[wiki-links]] between notes.
steps.tasks-timeline.title: Tasks & Timeline
steps.tasks-timeline.description: Kanban board for tasks and incident timelines with MITRE ATT&CK mappings and geo-maps.
steps.evidence.title: Evidence
steps.evidence.description: Import source files such as documents, spreadsheets and exports. Review what was extracted and turn table rows into IOCs.
steps.identities.title: Identities
steps.identities.description: The people, organizations, systems and accounts in a case. Private details stay masked and are never sent to AI.
steps.products.title: Products
steps.products.description: Compose the report from the case: pick a template, stage the notes, events and IOCs it needs, and export it.
steps.graph-iocs.title: Graph & IOCs
steps.graph-iocs.description: Interactive entity graph for IOCs, notes, and events. See aggregate IOC stats in the IOCs view.
steps.chat.title: CaddyAI
steps.chat.description: AI-powered investigation assistant — search notes, extract IOCs, create entities, and analyze threats.
steps.finish.title: You're All Set
steps.finish.description: Press Ctrl+K anytime to search, or revisit this tour from the header. Happy investigating!
